history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V8 workload, mode, jobs, checksum, timing boundary, engine-availability, and acceptance decision. It versions only the opt-in attribution inventory; any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Adds exact opt-in VM dispatch, VM quick-kernel, native runtime-operation, embedding host-callback, and WebAssembly export-dispatch counters. It also makes the already-versioned native-code lifetime and precise-heap fields explicit in the matrix contract. Timing rows remain uninstrumented.

tier_attribution.scope: one fresh zig-js context per workload and structural variant
tier_attribution.invocation: one inherited full-work call with the frozen jobs and lane-zero input
tier_attribution.equivalence: For warmup and invocation independently, each base/variant pair must select the same non-empty set of tree-walker, VM, baseline, optimizer, optimizer-OSR, and deoptimization paths and allocate exactly the same number of environments. Exact tier and runtime counters remain visible rather than normalized away; every Wasm workload must record an invocation-phase Wasm dispatch.
tier_attribution.timing_isolation: Attribution uses fresh opt-in contexts outside every scored timing row; normal contexts retain null telemetry and perform no profiling atomics.

recognizer_audit.prohibited: Every representative workload identifier is absent from engine source. Identifiers exist only in the owned workload, manifest, and benchmark tooling.
